description:
UCS_Murrey's Math Oscillator_V2
(close-min(len,low)+(((max(len,high)-min(len,low))*mult)*4))/((max(len,high)-min(len,low))/2) > 2.75
Has 3 parameters
1. LOOKBACKPERIOD -- Parameter in max and  min function
2. multiplication factor -- (default:0.125) parameter multiplied to difference between max and min functions
3. timeframe
4. varies from 1 to 3  
    greater than > 2.75 overbought?
    less than < 1.25 oversold?
atlas_query: ( cash ( 1 day ago "close *  volume" > 1000000000 and( latest close - latest min( 100 , latest low ) + ( ( ( latest max( 100 , latest high ) - latest min( 100 , latest low ) ) * 0.125 ) * 4 ) ) / ( ( latest max( 100 , latest high ) - latest min( 100 , latest low ) ) / 2 ) > 2.99 ) )

filters.verbatim: ( daily close - daily min( 100 ,  daily low ) + ( ( ( daily max( 100 ,  daily high ) - daily min( 100 ,  daily low ) ) * 0.125 ) * 4 ) ) / ( ( daily max( 100 ,  daily high ) - daily min( 100 ,  daily low ) ) / 2 ) > 2.99
